definitions.explanation: The place or point where something begins; can be used both literally (for journeys) and figuratively (for arguments, careers, etc.).

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is the starting point of the discussion.

examples.japanese: {出発点|しゅっぱつてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: To return to the starting point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: To stand at a new starting point.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧ (departure) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point). Used both literally for physical journeys and figuratively for ideas, arguments, and careers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出発点|しゅっぱつてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at a starting point
- {出発点|しゅっぱつてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the starting point
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}: a new starting point
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出発点|しゅっぱつてん}: the starting point of a discussion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起点|きてん}→起点：16254_kiten⟧: starting point, origin (often for routes or measurements)
- ⟦{原点|げんてん}→原点：11828_genten⟧: origin, starting point (implies going back to fundamentals: ⟦{原点|げんてん}→原点：11828_genten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧)
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧: departure (the act of leaving, not the location)
